name: ec-merger-phase2-opening

source.publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Competition - EU Competition: Merger case publications (open data case register)
source.vintage_last_modified: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 01:23:54 GMT (the register rolls over daily; this release pins the 2026-10-27 vintage)
source.requests_note: one anonymous GET of the bulk case register case-data-M.json (42,034,960 B, sha256 420411333e9b9fc27e0c2e72cbbbb419f1ba4125e7f40d98a9bc5e0911316702); stable tokenless S3 URL, no key
source.fetch_provenance: worker job ec-merger-003 (server 172772422, cx23/hel1) fetched the publisher directly; the bytes never passed through the coordinator. The panel was first measured at discovery on 2026-10-24 (42,025,677 B) and re-pinned at construction on 2026-10-27 (42,034,960 B) - the daily object grows as new cases arrive

grain: one row per merger case notified to the European Commission under the EU Merger Regulation (caseType MergerCaseType1 with a recorded caseNotificationDate); 10,125 eligible cases in the pinned vintage, 10,091 shipped after censoring 33 pending cases

eligibility.excluded_breakdown: 244 Merger + 2 Consultation + 26 Additional Procedure cases with no caseNotificationDate
eligibility.pending_censored_note: 29 cases with no decisions at all (26 are live 2020s filings), 3 Art. 9(3) partial referrals, 1 Art. 4(4) partial referral - counted per split, never labelled

label.rule: phase2_opened = 1 iff the case carries at least one 'Art. 6(1)(c)' decision adopted on/after its notification date; 'Withdrawal of Art. 6(1)(c)' decisions never match; ever-adopted (a later withdrawal does not undo the opener)
pre_notification_opener_cases: M.3333 (SONY/BMG re-notification; label decisions predating notification do not count - the case stays positive on its 2007-03-01 opener)

fixtures.source: IP/07/1695 + IP/08/458; as-of sector fixture against OJ prior notice C 230, 2.10.2007, p. 12 (CELEX C2007/230/08)
IP/22/5364; the 2024-09-06 post-ECJ withdrawal does not undo the opener under the ever-adopted rule

hazards_measured.notification_to_opener_lag_months: 0 mo: 1, 1 mo: 201, 2 mo: 101, thin tail 3-18 mo (suspended-clock and extended cases)
hazards_measured.register_corrections_note: the register is a current snapshot and revises historical records (e.g. M.10188's post-ECJ withdrawal appears in history); no historical vintages are retained, so past availability cannot be probed

full_model_stock_xgboost.source: worker job ec-merger-baseline-001, benchmark runner verbatim

sector_division_rate.source: required comparator; train rate per NACE division

recent_rate_constant.definition: train rate over the last three train years 2011-2013 (0.02659)

references_eval_1770_rows_46_positives.persistence: inapplicable: each row is a newly notified case with no prior observation of the same entity; the nearest analogue is recent_rate

full_model_minus_sector_division.reading: interval contains zero (inconclusive difference); observed gap negative - the stock baseline trails the required comparator

prevalence_shift_note: train 4.01% -> eval 2.60% -> holdout 1.58%: the falling Phase II rate across the enforcement era makes the holdout an out-of-distribution test in prevalence as much as in time; reported as a property, not a construction fault

measurement_commands.baseline: runner-contract baseline job ec-merger-baseline-001: gate --accept on fetched bytes, then python train.py + sh validate.sh unmodified, then report.py (model per-row scores via predict_proba + paired bootstrap vs the references)
measurement_commands.majority_rule: majority = int(train_positive_rate >= 0.5); accuracy measured against this split's labels
